artboards.title: How a plugin loads — static vs dynamic

annotations.text:
Four forks settled 2026-08-30.
1. Preload is a server-side tier only — no client-side static set.
2. Static remotes register before paint, load lazily (BR-AS08 intact).
3. Disconnect marks unavailable; only unregister or disable withdraws.
4. Manifest provenance signing, required on dynamic entries only.

Everything live here is gated on Phase 3 decision 47.
Without reactive contribution state, contributionRegistry's arrays and bootShell's statuses Map never re-render — so live injection, live withdrawal and the red dot are invisible however correct the service side is.

Still open.
• Does a dynamic plugin get a full scope.dispose(), or contribution-removal only with the module left resident? The second is roughly a fifth of the work and delivers all of the visible behaviour — a federated container cannot truly be un-evaluated anyway.
• Revocation fan-out: one revision touching an unbounded set of entries.
